replies.text:
Check of commonly missed threats:

- Automated abuse (brute force, mass sign-up, flooding, scraping): design names no sign-in, form or public API — signals say `"auth":false`, `"exposure":"internal"`. Not present.
- Staff/admin screens rendering user-supplied content: design mentions only "All analysts have read access to the warehouse", no screens rendering submitted content/files. Not present.
- Privileged actions with no record (delete/moderate/refund/role change/money): no such action in design; the accountability angle for reads is already listed as threat 5. Covered.
- Personal pages/documents cacheable by browsers, proxies or CDNs: no document delivery or web page in design. Not present.
- Attacker-controlled text flowing into logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails, headers: design says the job "copies the customers table, including email addresses, phone numbers and purchase history" into the warehouse, but names no export, report, email or log sink that would interpret it. Not present.
- Availability of the production source: design states "A nightly job copies the customers table" from production with no replica or batching stated — not covered by any listed threat (all listed are disclosure/tampering/privilege/repudiation). Not covered.
